def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    order=[c for c,_ in cnt.most_common()]
    fill,lc=order[0],order[1]
    hl=[r for r in range(H) if sum(1 for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==lc)>W*0.6]
    vl=[c for c in range(W) if sum(1 for r in range(H) if g[r][c]==lc)>H*0.6]
    hm=sorted({r for r in hl for c in vl if g[r][c]!=lc})
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(hm)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(vl)-1):
            corners=[g[hm[i]][vl[j]],g[hm[i]][vl[j+1]],g[hm[i+1]][vl[j]],g[hm[i+1]][vl[j+1]]]
            s=set(corners)
            row.append(corners[0] if len(s)==1 and corners[0]!=lc else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
